source_table: Mine Statistics (Copper), three months ended June 30, physical page 8
volume_basis: ALREADY_BARRICK_ATTRIBUTABLE; ownership retained as metadata, not multiplied again
projection: Freeze Q2 sales and unit CoS at each mine for all forward quarters; explicit scenario assumption, not a mine forecast or company guidance
rounding_note: Mine unit costs and kt volumes are rounded source values; weighted mine CoS need not equal reported total exactly. Capex components do not sum exactly to total because total includes other capitalized amounts.
cash_flow_scope: CoS margin added before the common methodological tax/growth/ROIC transform; NOT reconciled EBITDA/FCFF. Capex and depreciation are source facts, not additional deductions in this margin experiment.
excluded_growth_projects: Lumwana Super Pit expansion incremental production and investment plan
limitations: Copper realized-price vs COMEX basis not estimated
Gold/copper dependence assumed independent, not estimated
No full corporate equity bridge or per-share fair value
Mine reserves and closure obligations not modeled
Frozen gold operating-vector chronology inherited from baseline and not reforecast here
